prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
engine_stated_criteria: Best if you want a chain shop with installation flexibility
answer_verbatim:
If you want the safest **default recommendation** for buying tires and getting them installed in Pleasanton, **Seever & Sons Tire** and **Tire Choice Auto Service Center** are the strongest local options from the results, with **Big O Tires** close behind for a larger chain experience.[3][4][6][13][17]

- **Best overall local tire shop:** **Seever & Sons Tire** at 3687 Old Santa Rita Rd. It is family-owned, has been serving the area since 1983, sells major brands like Michelin, BFGoodrich, Uniroyal, and specializes in brakes and alignments in addition to tires.[3][5][7]
- **Best for broad tire selection + installation convenience:** **Tire Choice Auto Service Center** at 4216 Rosewood Rd. It says it carries BFGoodrich, Goodyear, Yokohama, Michelin, Pirelli and more, offers tire installation, repairs, alignments, and has extended daily hours.[4][17]
- **Best if you want a chain shop with installation flexibility:** **Big O Tires** at 3688A Washington St. It offers tire mounting, balancing, rotations, alignments, and says it can install tires even if you bought them elsewhere.[6][13][14]

For **installation quality**, the results point most strongly to **Seever & Sons Tire** and **Big O Tires**, because both emphasize professional tire mounting plus alignment/balancing services, and both appear in Tire Rack’s Pleasanton installer listings.[8][15][16] If you want the most comprehensive service package and easier scheduling, **Tire Choice** is the most convenient choice based on its hours and “ready to install today” wording.[4]

A practical pick by need:
- **Best workmanship-focused local shop:** Seever & Sons Tire[3][5]
- **Best selection and scheduling:** Tire Choice[4][17]
- **Best chain option / install-only flexibility:** Big O Tires[6][13][14]

If you want, I can also rank these by **price**, **hours**, or **best place to buy Michelin/Goodyear/Pirelli specifically**.
